name: pd_schedule_overrides_create
description: Create an override for a specific user covering the specified time range on a schedule (POST /schedules/{id}/overrides)

schedule_id.description: The ID of the schedule to create the override on (path {id} of POST /schedules/{id}/overrides).

user_id.description: The ID of the user who will be on call during the override (override.user.id).

start.description: The start date and time for the override, ISO 8601 (override.start).

end_time.description: The end date and time for the override, ISO 8601 (the API's override.end field).
